# Contributing to Next App

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## 📝 Commit Messages

We strictly follow a commit convention to ensure our history is readable and semantic.

👉 **[Read the Commit Convention Guide](COMMIT_CONVENTION.md)**

## 🚀 Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feat/amazing-feature`)
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'feat(auth): add login server action'`)
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feat/amazing-feature`)
5. Open a Pull Request

Thank you!
